semanticTypes.name: MemberEmail
semanticTypes.$comment: Client-supplied email address that identifies a workspace member. Minted by the caller when invoking addMember (body.email); planner generates a deterministic value at that site. The WorkspaceMemberMembership edge binding on removeMember resolves the path-param email from the same minted value.

semanticTypes.name: CatalogAssetKey
semanticTypes.$comment: Key identifying an ingested catalog asset — the asset's server-minted UUID, NOT the element template's `id` (the API exposes that separately as `resourceId`). Modelled as client-minted only because ingestCatalogAssets returns 204 (no response body), so the planner cannot chain the key out of the producer; scripts/e2e/run-hub.sh ingests the fixture, reads the real key back off searchCatalogAssets (`items[].assetKey`, matched on `resourceId`), and injects it via POS_FIXTURE_CATALOG_ASSET_KEY.
